name: critique
description: Standalone AI Code Reviewer & PR Quality Gatekeeper for CLI and GitHub Actions

scripts.version:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('plugin.json','utf-8'));p.version=v;fs.writeFileSync('plugin.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');const r=fs.readFileSync('README.md','utf-8');fs.writeFileSync('README.md',r.replace(/ajxcodes\/critique@v[\d.]+/g,'ajxcodes/critique@v'+v));console.log('Synced version to v'+v);"
scripts.postversion: npm run version:sync && git add plugin.json README.md

author: Alvin Jorrel Pascual <me@ajx.codes> (https://github.com/ajxcodes)
